scope: A deterministic read-only composition view of the currently closed ordinary property-38 candidate category and losslessly queued TurnInsertAbility records. It intentionally performs no cross-category scheduler arbitration.
selected_model: Build SchedulerCandidateState from two independent state domains: (1) use the closed ordinary participation/alive projection and property-38 stable comparator to expose ordered ordinary candidate IDs; (2) copy immutable PendingInsertedAction queue records in enqueue order. Return an explicit UNRESOLVED_PENDING_INSERT_ACTION_ARBITRATION status. The view neither selects nor executes a pending inserted action and does not import behavior-level ActionDelayState into property 38.
state_reads: OrdinaryTurnTimeline and settled ordinary participation/alive state
state_writes: none; SchedulerCandidateState is an immutable diagnostic/reference view
ordering: The ordinary category has the independently frozen remaining-delay/prior-list ordering. The pending category has independently frozen source enqueue order. No ordering relation between categories is claimed or calculated.

evidence.support: Supplies the closed ordinary property-38 comparator and completion scope.
Supplies the state-derived ordinary participation/alive projection.
Supplies the lossless source-order pending insertion record and explicitly leaves its arbitration unclosed.
A real Black Swan TurnInsertAbility operation reaches the pending queue and then appears beside ordinary candidates without any inferred selection.

strict_rejection: selecting a pending action from InsertAbilityPriority
using pending queue position as an AV/turn priority
claiming a legal action, active action, or completion transition from this read-only view
unsupported_boundary: pending action target resolution or execution
AV reset/reorder or turn consumption for inserted actions
dsh_implementation_contract: Preserve ordinary candidates and inserted-action records as separate typed scheduler inputs. Expose deterministic order within each category, but require a separately frozen arbitration policy before selecting a cross-category next action. This view must never mutate BattleState or provide a silent fallback to ordinary selection when a pending inserted action exists.
